title: The Three Gates of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: "Just as the three gate phantoms gradually faded, a sharp warning echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record—the fourth gate was slowly opening."

text.content: "When Ye Qing stumbled through the stone doors of the Observer's Hall, Chen Ji stood before the three light gates manifested by the Tianji Record. The Demonic Path Saintess's shoulder bore charred burns, the sacred mark between her brows dimmed to near invisibility, and her usually cold and elegant features now carried a desperate vulnerability. 'They... discovered us.' Ye Qing braced against the door frame, breath still ragged, 'The Holy Sect elders are in pursuit—just three li away.'"

"Chen Ji did not move. Three li was merely a finger's snap for an ordinary cultivator. He merely glanced淡淡 at the wound on Ye Qing's shoulder—the mark left by the Xuanwu Sect's Blazing Flame Art, the charred edges still radiating residual heat. 'Han Lie's work?' His tone was as calm as asking about today's weather. Ye Qing nodded: 'He's gone mad, burning anyone in sight.' Chen Ji's lips curved into the faintest trace of a smile as he made a mental note of this debt."

"Three li away. Enough time for a complete divination. Chen Ji slowly turned around; the Tianji Record's phantom behind him rippled like water disturbed by an invisible hand, the outlines of three light gates growing ever clearer. The first gate glowed with a desolate gray-white, the character '破' (Break) inscribed on its lintel; the second gate呈现深邃的墨色，一个'执'字悬浮门楣之上；第三道门则燃烧着幽冷的金色火焰，门框上是一个'殉'字。命运的三种终极走向，此刻尽数展开在他面前。

"Path One, Break the Dao. The vision unfolded in his mind—he saw himself using the Tianji Record Fragment as a blade, piercing the core of the Heavenly Eye's will. The rules of the Three Realms shattered in that moment, Heaven collapsed, reincarnation severed, all techniques, formations, and the path to immortality that relied on these rules turned to nothing. He saw the seal on Ye Qing dissolve, but simultaneously, countless cultivators vaporized in the rule vacuum—including defenseless mortals."

dialogue.content: "The one who breaks the Dao gains great freedom, yet without Heaven's order, the Three Realms perish together. This is not liberation—it is annihilation."

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice drifted from the first page, carrying a warmth Chen Ji had never heard before. Chen Ji closed his eyes; the vision shifted as the second gate crashed open in his consciousness. He saw himself seated upon the Heavenly Chessboard, the Heavenly Eye transformed into a discarded piece in his palm. The causal laws of all worlds flowed from his fingertips—he had become the new Chess Player. Yet the him in the vision had ice for features, no joy or sorrow, no love or hate, not even Chen Nian's name could stir a flicker of emotion."

dialogue.content: "The one who holds the Dao gains great power, yet the heart dies to ash—what difference from a puppet? Everything you treasure will turn to dust before power."

text.content: "The third path. Martyr the Dao. In the vision he and the Heavenly Eye were trapped together within the Primordial Seal, trading eternal slumber for the Three Realms' peace. Chen Nian placed a white flower at the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate—that was her first tear shed for her brother, yet she would never receive his response. Su Qingyao sat枯坐到天明 in the Observer's Hall, clutching a Fragment he left behind, never speaking another word. 'The martyr's soul never transcends,因果不沾，来世不记。' Mo Xiansheng's voice lowered, 'Are you certain you want her to wait a lifetime?'"

"Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, fine beads of sweat on his temples. Three endings, three futures he wanted none of. The three light gates still floated quietly behind him, each emanating a different-colored glow. He listened—distant spiritual fluctuations殿外传来——Han Lie's aura like boiling magma, closing in, along with a colder presence, the Holy Sect elder."

"Ye Qing approached his side, whispering: 'Three li, now only one. Chen Ji, we must go.' Her voice carried rare urgency, her gaze falling on the three gates—her pupils constricted sharply: 'This is... the Path of Destiny? How could you see these?' Chen Ji gave no answer. His full attention gathered at the Tianji Record's core—where an imperceptible crack he had never noticed before radiated a fourth light distinctly different from the three gates."

"The light was too faint, nearly undetectable. Yet this very imperceptibility carried an inexplicable eeriness. Chen Ji stared at the crack; the Tianji Record's feedback manifested in his Mental Sea as blurred visions—a chaos without Break's freedom, without Hold's power, without Martyr's sorrow, only suffocating darkness and... a vague silhouette. The figure's outline felt hauntingly familiar."

"Mo Xiansheng's voice rang again, this time with unprecedented tension: 'The fourth gate... you should not see this.' 'Why?' Chen Ji asked in his mind. The remnant soul沉默了很长时间，长到夜清都开始不安地四处张望。最终墨先生只说了一句：'因为它不在天机录的推演范围之内。换言之——'陈机接过他的话：'它是变数。'

"A variable. Chen Ji calculated rapidly in his mind. He had divined countless futures with the Tianji Record—never had anything exceeded the scope of divination. Chen Nian—her visions were always blurred because she was the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' disrupting the Tianji Record's operation. Could this fourth gate... operate on the same principle? An option deliberately concealed, a path erased by the Heavenly Eye? Chen Ji suddenly felt an inexplicable chill."

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng, you said the Tianji Record is the obsession of generations of prophets. Then where did the Heavenly Eye come from? Between it and the Tianji Record—which is the original sin?'

text.content: "The殿外的 spiritual fluctuations abruptly intensified. Han Lie's roar echoed across several li, the scorching heat palpable even through the barrier. 'Chen Ji! I know you're in there!' The Xuanwu Sect's premier genius's voice carried suppressed fury pushed to the limit, 'If you dare hide again today, I'll raze this Observer's Hall to the ground!' Ye Qing's expression shifted, her hidden weapon蓄势待发. Chen Ji remained motionless; his gaze pierced the殿墙, as if seeing Han Lie's face twisted with rage."

"'This man Han Lie,' Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice carrying a cold amusement, 'combat power逆天, yet simple-minded. Every time I suppress him, he falls into deeper obsession.' He turned to Ye Qing: 'Let him burn. The Observer's Hall's barrier can hold for a quarter hour. After that, the Holy Sect elder and he will collide—do you think, given Han Lie's nature, will he burn even the Holy Sect elder?'"

dialogue.content: "You... you want them to annihilate each other? But the Holy Sect elder is your ally—'

"'Never was. I merely planted a fire-attracting talisman on him, and told the Holy Sect elder,' Chen Ji said casually, 'that this Observer's Hall contains the Tianji Record's whereabouts. Now both sides think the other wants to monopolize the fortune—do you think this is called?'"
"'A standoff between蚌 and鹬, with渔翁 reaping the benefits... You calculated this move from the start? But how could you be certain Han Lie would definitely come?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not answer directly. He redirected his gaze to the fourth crack deep within the Tianji Record, his mind rapidly reviewing each move. The Three Great Sects' rivalry, the Demonic Path invasion, the Ancient Forbidden Land's opening—these major events he had already divined滴水不漏. Yet the word 'variable' was like a thorn embedded in his perfect chess game. An existence beyond the Tianji Record's divination—could it be a flaw, or an answer deliberately erased? Chen Nian's figure flashed in his mind, those always-blurred visions."

choice.prompt: "Three gates set, the fourth hidden yet appearing. Chen Ji, which path will you choose?"

choices.description: "Wield the Tianji Record as a blade to pierce the Heavenly Eye, trading the collapse of the Three Realms' rules for absolute freedom."
choices.visible_cost: "The Three Realms' rules collapse; billions of cultivators and mortals perish together."
choices.visible_reward: "Break free from destiny's chains, become an existence beyond Heaven."
choices.risk_hint: "The price too severe—even if successful, the remainder of life would bear the name of world-destruction."

text.content: "Chen Ji reached toward the first gate. The pallid lintel trembled faintly at his fingertips, a grand force pouring into his palm—destruction's exhilaration mixed with heavy sin. He felt the Three Realms' karma begin崩解 in that touch; countless spiritual meridians like severed threads dissipated between his fingers."

choices.description: "Take the Heavenly Eye's place, trading the loss of humanity to become the new Chess Player."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely lose human emotions; Chen Nian and Su Qingyao will no longer recognize him."
choices.visible_reward: "Command all causal laws of the heavens; every destiny under control."
choices.risk_hint: "A heart-dead Chess Player—what difference from a puppet?"

text.content: "Chen Ji touched the second gate. The ink-black lintel was biting cold, a chill penetrating his marrow. He saw his consciousness beginning to剥离情绪—fear, love, hate, attachments, stripped away bit by bit. Strangely, he felt no pain, only a terrible calm."

choices.description: "Be trapped with the Heavenly Eye within the Primordial Seal, trading eternal sacrifice for the Three Realms' peace."
choices.visible_cost: "The soul never transcends; Chen Nian will forever wait for her brother to never return."
choices.visible_reward: "The Three Realms preserved; Chen Nian's seal released; everyone he cares about survives."
choices.risk_hint: "Sacrifice is set; the remainder of life holds only endless darkness and solitude."

text.content: "Chen Ji walked toward the third gate. The cold golden flames burned around him but did not scorch his body—only bringing martyrdom's soul-deep pain. He saw Chen Nian place a white flower at the Tianqing Sect gate, saw Su Qingyao sit until dawn in the Observer's Hall—the visions realistic as personal experience."

"Just as Chen Ji's fingers were about to touch the first gate, the Tianji Record violently shuddered. The hidden fourth crack suddenly expanded, erupting blinding white light that overwhelmed all three gates' radiance. Mo Xiansheng's voice became unprecedentedly urgent: 'Stop! The fourth gate is interfering with your choice—it is absorbing your Heavenly Fate Value!' Chen Ji looked down at his hands—fine light points were indeed seeping from his fingerprints, flowing endlessly toward that fourth gate."

"'The fourth gate... what exactly is it?' Chen Ji steadied his mind, forcefully withdrawing his fingers. The Heavenly Fate drain ceased instantly, yet that white light continued spreading, as if an invisible eye was gazing through this gate. Suddenly, a thought struck him—Chen Nian. The blurred figure in the vision, the existence disrupting the Tianji Record's foresight... Could the fourth gate lead not to some result, but to Chen Nian herself?"

"A deafening explosion came from outside the hall. Han Lie's fury finally burned through the barrier; scorching heat flipped half the hall's roof. Yet the next instant, another icy presence descended—Holy Sect elder's Annihilation Palm collided with Han Lie's flames; spiritual counter-shock reduced the Observer's Hall's remaining barriers to fragments. In the chaos, Chen Ji，反而看清了第四道门的轮廓——那不是一个终点，而是一个入口。一扇通往'尚未发生的可能性'的门。"

"Chen Ji withdrew his hand. Three known paths of fate floated quietly behind him, while the fourth gate's light was visibly devouring its three 'companions.' Time was running out. Once the fourth gate fully formed, the projections of the three old paths would vanish entirely—then he would have only this untraveled unknown path. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently in the first page, seeming to want to speak, yet suppressed back by an invisible force."

choice.prompt: "Three old paths are being devoured by the unknown. Chen Ji, will you abandon divination and choose to face this unpredictable variable?"

choices.description: "Abandon the three known paths and choose to enter that divination-defying unknown gate—Chen Nian may be waiting behind it."
choices.visible_cost: "Lose all divination advantages, enter a completely unknown realm."
choices.visible_reward: "Perhaps find the key to breaking fate—也可能面对比天道更可怕的存在."
choices.risk_hint: "This is the only variable, also potentially the most dangerous gamble."

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath and strode toward the fourth gate. The white light within was warm and gentle, resembling the hand of young Chen Nian leading his. Chen Ji suddenly smiled—原来这扇门，从来不是深渊，而是归途。光芒将他的身影吞没的一瞬，他在心中轻轻说了一句：念念，哥哥来接你了。"

choices.description: "Use Heavenly Fate Value to forcibly suppress the fourth gate's expansion, maintaining the three known paths to buy more decision time."
choices.visible_cost: "Significant Heavenly Fate Value consumed; the body may suffer backlash."
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve the three known paths; gain opportunity for detailed discussion with Mo Xiansheng."
choices.risk_hint: "The fourth gate will not disappear, only lie dormant—下一次出现时可能更加猛烈."

text.content: "Chen Ji formed seals with both hands; the Tianji Record unfolded fully before him. Using his own Heavenly Fate Value as an anchor, he forced that white light back into the crack. The three old paths' light stabilized once more, but the cost was a violent dizziness—he felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining rapidly,细密的刺痛 emanating from certain body parts."

"The outside battle intensified. Han Lie's roar and Holy Sect elder's sinister laugh intertwined; spiritual counter-shock shredded the Observer's Hall's remnant barriers to bits. Ye Qingnervous地看着陈机——他站在原地，双目微闭，眉心拧成一个深邃的结。He was thinking, thinking profoundly. Ye Qing had never seen someone maintain such absolute composure in such chaos, as if the external collapse was unrelated to him."

"Chen Ji opened his eyes. In his pupils' depths, the Tianji Record's three gates and fourth crack reflected simultaneously—brilliant yet eerie. He looked at Ye Qing and suddenly asked an inexplicable question: 'If there was a path that could free you from the Holy Sect's control, but required your life as the price—would you choose it?' Ye Qingwas momentarily stunned，随即毫不hesitated地点头：'选。我早就不想再做圣宗的棋子了。' Chen Ji's lips curved into a genuine smile: '好。记住了这句话。'"

"Chen Ji turned to face the four gates. The hall beams above collapsed under spiritual counter-shock, raising clouds of dust. Ye Qing instinctively shielded her head; Chen Ji stood unmoved,任由碎屑从他肩头滑落。 His gaze穿透尘埃与混乱，定定地落在第四道门上——那扇门后的白光，正随着外面战斗的加剧而愈发明亮，仿佛有什么东西正在从门后苏醒。"

"'I have noted it.' Chen Ji suddenly said quietly. Ye Qing was stunned: 'Note what?' Chen Ji gave no answer. He merely默念着韩烈的名字，将这笔账妥帖地收进了他那本从不出错的账簿之中。 The outside roar drew nearer; spiritual fluctuations surged like a tsunami. Yet Chen Ji's heart was surprisinglycalm——因为他已经看到了第四道门后那个模糊身影的真容。"

"It was Chen Nian. Not the Chen Nian trapped deep in the Holy Sect, but another Chen Nian—one untouched by the Heavenly Eye, pristine. The fourth gate led not to destruction, nor to power, but to a 'possibility not yet written by fate.' There, Chen Nian was not the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, but the final key to breaking heavenly secrets—simultaneously Chen Ji's ultimate weakness and strongest trump card."

"The Tianji Record shuddered violently, emitting a sharp warning. Chen Ji looked down—the fourth gate's crack had expanded to three times its original size; white light nearly溢出裂隙。 Mo Xiansheng's voice响起，带着前所未有的pressing感：'第四道门正在强行打开——门后不是深渊，是陈念！但如果你在它稳定之前进入，你们两个都将被命运的反噬吞噬！' Chen Ji looked at Ye Qing: '带我出去。我们去找她。'"
